mapper.select: SELECT b.case_list_id basic_case_list_id, b.file_name basic_file_name, b.file_original_name basic_file_original_name, b.file_type, b.file_url basic_file_url, b.is_required, a.* FROM case_info_list a RIGHT JOIN basic_case_list b ON b.case_list_id = a.case_list_id AND a.case_info_id = ${caseInfoId} WHERE b.case_type = ${caseType};
